thread:
alana: Heads-up — seeing sticky traffic on the v2 gateway for a small set of mobile tenants (latency tails, retries up). Putting a soft hold on the staged shift. https://rwd.internal/ops/graph/txn-754
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary stage 3 -> 10% at 1768130000, auto-monitoring enabled. Will execute unless paused by an operator within the next 5m.
dinesh: Can you paste the curl that triggered the retries? might be client header mismatch.
alana: quick log snippet: `WARN rpc: downstream retry=3 route=v2/mobile tenant=tn-42 header: X-Client-Version=1.2.0`
maria_mobile: This is the mobile cohort we rolled forward last week — asking to pin tn-42 and tn-57 until we confirm SDK-side fix.
ryan_ops: What are our rollback criteria for this shift? e.g., 95p latency > 600ms OR error-rate delta > 0.5% for 5m?
dinesh: Agree with ryan. Also add: sustained retry rate > 0.3% for 3 consecutive intervals.
deploy-bot: OK — applying temporary pin for tenants: [tn-42, tn-57] via deploybot API. Command: `deploybot pin add --route v2 --tenants tn-42,tn-57 --reason "mobile sdk header mismatch"`
alana: Thanks. Pausing the canary now. @deploy-bot can you confirm pause and snapshot telemetry? :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary paused at 0% (stage 3 aborted). Snapshot created: s3://rwd-telemetry/canary/1768129989/snapshot.json
maria_mobile: I'll notify mobile-eng to cut a patch for header negotiation. Can we also add a short note in the release notes to warn mobile integrators about v2 header case-sensitivity?
ryan_ops: Yes — release notes entry: "Temporary pause: v2 rollout paused for affected mobile tenants due to header negotiation issue; tenants tn-42 and tn-57 pinned. Operators monitoring. Will resume after SDK patch and verification."
dinesh: Quick checklist before resume: 1) SDK patch shipped and rolled to alpha 2) telemetry 30m healthy with retry/error thresholds 3) operator signoff
alana: I'll own operator signoff. maria, please paste the SDK PR link here when ready.
maria_mobile: PR -> https://git.internal/mobile/pulls/842 — will post updates.
ryan_ops: Marking rollback window in deploybot as: auto-rollback if any of the criteria met within 30m of resume. Operators, be on-call during resume.
dinesh: thanks team. small but important: add a one-liner in the console changelog so support sees it.
alana: done — console changelog updated. We'll reconvene if telemetry doesn't stabilize.
